change: Cache the sorted unique u16 active set after cooccurrence pruning. Pair increments retain input order and duplicate semantics. Skip the full pair-table retention scan only when the set is unchanged; changed membership still performs the original pruning. Cache is initialized on the first sample, including empty input; boxed storage is exactly two bytes per unique active index, at most 128 KiB plus Option metadata. No sampling/counter/schema/text changes.

fixture.scope: Original and active-set-cached pair sampling in the same retained release test binary, with a common History layout. 500 entities, 100 samples per child; stable, reordered and one-entity-churn workloads. Common setup validates counts and exact table iteration order with a shared hash builder. Not an app-wide comparison.
fixture.memory_scope: wait4 maximum process RSS includes common setup, both state-oracle histories and canonical-output encoding. It cannot isolate retained-cache or helper memory savings.

validation.oracle: Original sampling algorithm and candidate share a cloned hash builder; compare exact counts, actual table iteration order, resulting grouping text and active membership after each update. Covers stable/reordered/duplicate IDs, churn, empty first sample with stale entries, disappearance/reappearance and wrapped indices.

app_comparison.scope: Production packaging and app A/B required; helper CPU results do not establish app-wide CPU, physical footprint or wakeup savings.

build_investigation.scope: Compiler diagnostics only; no new build optimization or native backend adopted. Optimized and typecheck-only timings are different scopes and are not an A/B comparison. Native app build and all 212 UI cases pass, but packaging portability and comparative pressure are unverified; see pass 14.

typecheck.limits: Individual function timings include nested/lazy compiler work and are not additive exclusive CPU costs.

optimized_object_compilation.limits: Single UI module object-code diagnostic; excludes separate module emission, dependency outputs and linking. Phase timers are nested and cannot be summed.

excluded_setup_attempt.reason: Expired driver temporary supplementary-output map; no compiler started. Follow-up omits supplementary outputs and retains semantic flags/object outputs.

limits: Stable maximum-process RSS rises 16.93 to 17.32 MiB in the common fixture; reordered/churn means fall. Common setup/oracles and final encoding prevent isolated cache-memory attribution; no app memory saving claimed.
Only the sampling helper is timed. App cadence, complete History update, collector and UI work require separate app comparison.
